mission.title: Mistrust
mission.description: Find out who the second wireframed man fighting the intruder is.

npc.say: What? That's all I got. Jeez.
My god! What's wrong with those people? They just went crazy!

Pah. I can handle him.
Is he going to be a problem? Not if you do as I say. Don't trust him. Don't believe a damn thing he says.
"Don't trust him," huh? You know, that's the first thing he's said that I might actually take into consideration.
Yeah, well... I'd still rather be us than the Machines right about now.

phase.briefing: Warrior, the situation may have just gotten worse. A second wireframed man has been reported in combat with the intruder. Colt will have more details for you.

enter.say: Another one? Oh, great. Like we didn't have enough to worry about with the first guy.

talk.say:
Okay, here's what we've got so far. This new guy and the intruder supposedly fought, then split up. We're not sure what that was about, but it's looking like they don't like each other much.
Now we're getting reports of override programs being used nearby. We were able to get in touch with the intruder, and it doesn't seem to be him that's doing it, so money's on the new guy. You've been tabbed to go into the danger zone and see if you can turn anything up on him.

phase.briefing: Overridden programs have been reported at the indicated location, {player}. Be careful.

enter.say: Let me get a peeper on this... Huh. Override codes, all right. While you're in there, I'll see if I can compare them with the codes we've seen before.

done.say:
Okay, I'm not picking up anything else remarkable in there.
I've been checking how the codes compare, and they look like the intruder's codes--exactly like the intruder's codes, in fact. If those were from the new guy, then the two of them are sharing the same code base.

phase.briefing: We've been able to get a reading on the intruder's location, operative. He should be able to give us some information on the newcomer. We need to know if this new man is going to help or hinder our fight against the Machines.

enter.say: The intruder should be in there. Something tells me he's going to have grumpy face on today.

talk.say:
Annoying, is what it is. He's just trying to slow me down. But if he's come here now, then I must be close...
Hmh. He'll tell you sooner or later himself. His name is Carlyne. He'll call me Halborn. I've known him for a long time...long enough to know that he's a deceitful bastard who won't stop at anything to get what he wants. Lies with a smile--that's Carlyne all over. Only, I know him too well for that to work...so he's had to resort to this.

done.say: "Halborn," huh? Gee, and here I was kind of getting used to "intruder." "Halborn" is so...blah.

phase.briefing: Operative, Captain Niobe wants to talk to you about this development. I'm routing you to her location now.

enter.say:
You know, that whole "don't trust him" line was pretty ironic, considering whose wired lips it came from.
Captain's waiting for you in there.

talk.say:
Hm. Thanks for the information, {player}. I can see this turning into a real pain in the ass. If this Carlyne guy really is out to get the intruder--Halborn--then chances are that's going to keep Halborn so busy that he won't be much help against the Machines; and in the mean time, those two could be doing who knows what to the whole damn place.
We're going to have to get them sorted out, and fast, or we'll have two real big problems on our hands, and the Machines right behind them.

mission.finish: I think we all share the Captain's concerns, {player}. We also have to be cognizant of the fact that we have only Halborn's own word on this new arrival. If they are indeed rivals, then we can't assume that either of them will tell us the truth about the other.
